notes.title: Shadows on the Vatican Act II - Release date revealed!
notes.notes:
Hi guys, the long wait is over: we finally have an official release date for Act II: Wrath - and it's October 23! So, be ready to play and to send us your first impressions ;)

To celebrate the imminent release, ACT I will be discounted (-75%) for the whole week! Enjoy!
